admission.justification: Realized across language_catalog.lock.json, language_catalog.py, language_cache.py, language_scanner.py, and cli/languages.py, and guarded by multi-language catalog completeness and dependency-purity tests.

applicability: Bundled language_catalog.lock.json entries, language_catalog.py validation, language_cache.py direct pack-binding loading, and full-catalog warming via language_scanner.all_catalog_language_ids and cli/languages.py.
conditions: All 15 core pilot languages (c, cpp, rust, zig, go, java, csharp, kotlin, swift, ruby, php, bash, elixir, sql, hcl) are declared as pypi_wheel entries with guaranteeTier verified, pinned wheel SHA-256 hashes, and verified tagsQuerySha256 digests.

56 tree-sitter-language-pack==0.13.0 entries declare verified tags.scm digests and honest guaranteeTier values (verified or best_effort), loaded directly from AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE bindings/<lang>*.{so,pyd} without adding tree-sitter-* dependencies to mcp/pyproject.toml or mcp/uv.lock.
agents-remember languages warm --all enumerates all non-builtin catalog language IDs via all_catalog_language_ids() without hardcoding language lists.
exclusions: Local custom shared-library grammars registered via languages.json are governed by INV-EW1ST5 rather than the shipped catalog lock.
statement: The bundled hash-pinned language catalog admits 15 core pilot languages via pinned PyPI wheels and 56 tree-sitter-language-pack languages with verified tags.scm digests, explicit guaranteeTier classification, zero tree-sitter-* dependencies in pyproject.toml or uv.lock, and full-catalog warming via languages warm --all.
title: Hash-pinned catalog admits 15 pilots and 56 language-pack entries
